chapter_title_en: The Snake in the White Coat
chapter_seo_title: Chapter 594: A Threat from the Real World—Wang Wei Wants the Yang Life Pill
chapter_meta_description: Wang Wei has proof of Li Huowang's power and uses it to blackmail him during a tense New Year's Eve in the psych ward. A new kind of threat emerges from the real world.
og_title: A Cold Threat in the Hospital Ward
og_description: Wang Wei brings Yi Donglai's thesis to the ward, demanding a Yang Life Pill from Li Huowang.
twitter_title: When the Doctor Becomes the Predator
twitter_description: Wang Wei threatens to expose Li Huowang’s secret unless he delivers an immortality pill.

lore_anchors.definition: Li Huowang's former therapist who has become obsessed with proving that Li Huowang's "delusions" are real. He seeks to exploit Li Huowang's ability for personal gain.
The novel's term for a theoretical pill that would extend a person's lifespan. This concept is central to Wang Wei's new obsession.
A research document written by Li Huowang's original doctor, containing a comprehensive record of Li Huowang's hallucinations and confessions.
The annual Chinese New Year variety show broadcast by CCTV, a major cultural event watched by hundreds of millions of people.
